edges.limitations: A smaller g-ratio indicates a smaller axon relative to the whole myelinated fibre, not proof that all myelin properties are normal. nodes.description: Abnormal neurofilament organization is a variant-dependent feature of dominant NEFL neuropathy. N98S mice have inclusions in neuronal cell bodies and proximal axons. Aggregation demonstrated for N98S therefore cannot be assumed for every CMTDIG allele.

nodes.description: Heterozygous missense variants in NEFL encode abnormal neurofilament light subunits. CMTDIG pedigrees include p.Glu396Lys near the rod–tail junction and p.Asn98Ser; p.Leu312Pro and p.Ile384Phe also occur in intermediate-classified families. ClinGen supports a gain-of-function mechanism for dominant NEFL-related CMT, but the consequences for filament assembly, localization and stability depend on the variant and experimental context. This dominant presentation is distinct from neuropathy due to biallelic truncating variants within the rod domain.
